name: Automatic1111
overview: The classic, widely-used web interface for Stable Diffusion models.
details: Automatic1111 (A1111) was the original pioneer of the Stable Diffusion GUI ecosystem. It possesses a massive library of extensions and community tutorials.
While it has largely been superseded by ComfyUI and Forge for high-end performance, its API is still heavily utilized by legacy scripts and older AI generation pipelines.
